_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-okapi-facade container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-okapi-facade container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-okapi-facade container in MiB

deployment.description: mod-okapi-facade is stateless: it has no database, messaging or scheduled-job state and only translates read-only Okapi API calls into requests to mgr-applications, mgr-tenant-entitlements and mgr-tenants. Replicas are independent; the only local state is a per-replica tenant-applications cache. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient; requests are synchronous pass-through calls to the manager modules.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name; must match the value used by the other modules

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-okapi-facade process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-applications, used to resolve application and module descriptors

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the mgr-applications client

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for the mgr-applications client. Required when AM_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the mgr-applications client

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the mgr-applications client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: TE_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-tenant-entitlements, used to resolve the applications entitled for a tenant

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the mgr-tenant-entitlements client

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for the mgr-tenant-entitlements client. Required when TE_TLS_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the mgr-tenant-entitlements client

EnvVars.name: TE_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the mgr-tenant-entitlements client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: MT_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-tenants, used to resolve tenant details

EnvVars.name: MT_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the mgr-tenants client

EnvVars.name: MT_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for the mgr-tenants client. Required when MT_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: MT_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the mgr-tenants client

EnvVars.name: MT_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the mgr-tenants client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: TENANT_APPS_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time to live of the cached tenant-enabled applications
